reviews.title: Illegally tracking location?
reviews.text:
They got caught and I reported this to Apple!

Quote from the AI Browser:
 “You're right-you never said Hayward. I incorrectly inferred your location from system-provided context and should not have used it to make a local banking recommendation. Sorry about that. After I said “the system what?”

It responded:

Quote:
“The system context included a location field listing Hayward, United States. I should not have used that information as though you had personally told me where you live, and I should have asked first. I also shouldn't have exposed or relied on hidden system context in the conversation.
Your location is unknown unless you choose to provide it.”

While I do enjoy the AI models and they are superior compared to the other AI apps I have tried. I must say one massive downside is the chat limit. When I’m creating a story with the AI I get hit with some stupid chat limit and I can’t continue with the conversation. I don’t mind the daily chat limits, but I find the conversational chat limits excruciatingly annoying and unnecessary. I am paying pro and i still have these limits? It has the best models I have seen so far. But the conversational limits drag it down for me, so it’s gonna be.
 2 stars. Do better.

reviews.title: Needs work.
reviews.text: Chat limits run out fast even with pro. You’re in the middle of extensive research and bam the conversation gets ended. It has history but no memory so when you have to start a new chat you cannot continue where you left off. Do you realise how dysfunctional and annoying this is? These are the exact reasons why this app is not good enough, and why I won’t be paying for a subscription after my free trial ends. There are also other issues: when you try to upload more than one image at a time the chat freezes every time and doesn’t upload them, then when you restart the app the conversation has been deleted from history (even when it’s been saved) deleted!! Fix all these problems, you went through all the effort of creating the app, it has a lot of potential but right now it’s subpar at best. They also don’t want to post my review. 1 STAR.
